name: Hikari Micro Pellets
description: Slow-sinking micro pellets for small-mouthed community fish. Manufacturer guaranteed-analysis crude protein minimum is 48%. wasteFactor (0.25) is MODELLED — pellets are more contained than flakes (less drifts uneaten), so a lower default waste band.
notes: Midwater + small surface feeders. Pellets stay intact longer than flakes, so uneaten food is easier to siphon before it decays.
